messages.subject: Resources Executive | ESG, Government Relations & External Affairs Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Iron Cove Global Team,

Your resources and energy search work is strongly aligned with my leadership background. I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with responsibility across government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am exploring Director, VP, Country and Regional mandates across mining, resources and energy where regulatory credibility, stakeholder alignment and responsible development are central to value creation. Saudi Arabia and the UAE are priority markets, with broader international mobility.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
